from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extraction from a single legal document for classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the legal document (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or legal category explicitly mentioned in the text; None if not found or irrelevant to the target 7 categories")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
